common.connectHint: Sign in to your account to view the details.

absence.subject: {app} — Absence recorded
absence.title: Absence recorded
absence.intro: Hello {recipient}, an absence was recorded automatically (no scan or manual check-in) for “{person}”. Please sign in to justify it.
absence.introParent: Hello {recipient}, an absence was recorded automatically (no scan or manual check-in) for student “{person}”. Please sign in to justify it.
absence.note: Click the bell in the navigation bar to view details and submit your justification.

justification_submitted.subject: {app} — Absence justification received
justification_submitted.title: Justification received
justification_submitted.intro: Hello {recipient}, your absence justification was sent to “{school}”. You will be notified of the decision.
justification_submitted.introParent: Hello {recipient}, the absence justification for student “{person}” was sent to “{school}”. You will be notified of the decision.
justification_submitted.note: The response will also appear under the bell in your navigation bar.

justification_received.subject: {app} — Absence justification to review
justification_received.title: Justification to review
justification_received.intro: Hello {recipient}, {person} justified an absence. Please review it from the notification bell.
justification_received.note: Accept or reject the justification from the bell. A return is recorded automatically if accepted.

accepted.subject: {app} — Absence justification accepted
accepted.title: Justification accepted
accepted.intro: Hello {recipient}, your absence justification was accepted by “{school}”.
accepted.introParent: Hello {recipient}, the absence justification for student “{person}” was accepted by “{school}”.
accepted.note: A return was also recorded in your account.

rejected.subject: {app} — Absence justification rejected
rejected.title: Justification rejected
rejected.intro: Hello {recipient}, your absence justification was not accepted by “{school}”.
rejected.introParent: Hello {recipient}, the absence justification for student “{person}” was not accepted by “{school}”.
rejected.note: Check the bell for the decision reason.

return.subject: {app} — Return after absence
return.title: Return recorded
return.intro: Hello {recipient}, a return was recorded in your account after your justification was accepted.
return.introParent: Hello {recipient}, a return was recorded for student “{person}” after the justification was accepted.
return.note: The absence is now marked as excused.

created.title: Payment recorded
created.intro: A payment has just been recorded for your family.
created.subject: Payment recorded

updated.title: Payment updated
updated.intro: A payment for your family was updated by the school.
updated.subject: Payment updated

deleted.title: Payment cancelled
deleted.intro: A payment for your family was deleted (data entry error).
deleted.subject: Payment cancelled

results.subject: {app} — Results for {student}
results.title: School results
results.intro: Hello {parent}, here are the results for {student}{classSuffix} for {period} — {year}.

accountCreate.subject: {app} — Your account has been created
accountCreate.title: Your account has been created
accountCreate.intro: Hello {name}, an administrator created your {app} account with {context}. Your temporary credentials are ready: sign in at klambocore.com then change your password.
accountCreate.bodyLead: An administrator created your {app} account with {context}.
accountCreate.securityNote: For security, change this password after your first sign-in.
accountCreate.waSecurity: Change this password after signing in. Do not share it.

passwordReset.subject: {app} — Password reset
passwordReset.title: Password reset
passwordReset.intro: Hello {name}, your {app} password was reset by an administrator. Use the temporary password below to sign in at klambocore.com.
passwordReset.bodyLead: Your password was reset by an administrator.
passwordReset.securityNote: We recommend changing this password after you sign in.
passwordReset.securityNoteHtml: For security, change this password after signing in.
passwordReset.waSecurity: Change this password after signing in.

teacherSchedule.intro: here is the PDF of your {cycle} timetable.

inscription.title: Registration received
inscription.intro: Hello {name}, we have received your registration request.
